reason: I'd take the free six-week test because premium freight cost me real money last quarter, but I won't put $2,000 a month into a tool until I see it catch a shortage before my team would have. Our suppliers already ignore the portals we bought, so I doubt a drafted follow-up gets a faster answer.
objection: We tried supplier portals and suppliers ignored them. Why would they answer an email drafted by a tool they've never heard of?
would_change_my_mind: A six-week test where the morning list flags a late supplier early enough that we avoid at least one premium freight charge and suppliers actually reply to the follow-ups.
